name: Shaft avant-garde
summary: Clean flat cels in near-empty abstract architecture and saturated colour fields, cut with full-screen text cards and cut-paper collage worlds.

traits.line: thin clean lines; Akio Watanabe's sharp slender designs (Monogatari), Ume Aoki's round cute designs (Madoka)
traits.shading: flat cel colour with one shadow tone; large areas of pure flat colour
traits.palette: saturated colour fields (red, black, white, yellow); pastel cute figures against dark ominous sets
traits.lighting: abstract and theatrical; silhouettes against colour
traits.faces: extreme close-ups of eyes and lips; the sharp over-the-shoulder 'Shaft head tilt'
traits.backgrounds: near-empty geometric architecture, endless staircases, crowds absent; Inu Curry witch labyrinths of cut-paper collage and Eastern European stop-motion-like textures
traits.texture: paper collage, printed patterns, photographs, typographic overlays
traits.camera: rapid cuts, flashing full-screen text frames, asymmetric graphic compositions

style_words: Avant-garde digital TV anime in the Shaft manner, as in Bakemonogatari (2009) and Madoka Magica (2011): thin clean lines, flat cel colour, stark graphic compositions on near-empty geometric sets, saturated red, black, white and yellow colour fields, flashing full-screen text frames, cut-paper collage and stop-motion-like textures, printed patterns.

krea2.style: Avant-garde digital TV anime, as in Bakemonogatari: thin clean lines, flat cel colour with one shadow tone, stark asymmetric graphic compositions on near-empty geometric sets, large saturated colour fields of red, black, white and yellow, silhouettes against flat colour, cut-paper collage and stop-motion-like textures, plain unmarked panels, sparse open space.
krea2.recap: Rendered throughout as avant-garde digital TV anime with stark graphic colour fields and cut-paper collage.

flux3_klein.style: Avant-garde digital TV anime in the register of Shaft: thin clean lines, sharp slender figures, flat cel colour with one shadow tone, large areas of pure flat colour, stark asymmetric graphic composition, backgrounds simplified to near-empty geometric shapes, silhouettes set against flat colour fields, cut-paper collage textures and printed patterns pasted onto the background like a stop-motion set, unmarked flat surfaces, a clean digital finish.
flux3_klein.recap: Saturated red and yellow fill the sky and the walls as flat colour fields, black fills the ground and the shadow fills, white stays in the light sources and the highlights, and every garment keeps its own stated colour.

qwen_image_2_1.style: The image is an avant-garde digital TV animation frame in the Shaft manner, with thin clean lines, flat cel colour with one shadow tone in large areas of pure flat colour, stark graphic composition on near-empty geometric sets, cut-paper collage, stop-motion-like textures and printed patterns, depicting a scene from a Gothic Victorian novel in a palette of saturated colour fields of red, black, white and yellow.
qwen_image_2_1.recap: The overall composition places its forms off-centre in stark, asymmetric graphic layouts with silhouettes against colour, in a strange, theatrical mood, keeps to a palette of saturated colour fields of red, black, white and yellow, and reads throughout as an avant-garde digital TV animation frame in the Shaft manner, with thin clean lines, flat cel colour with one shadow tone in large areas of pure flat colour, stark graphic composition on near-empty geometric sets, cut-paper collage, stop-motion-like textures and printed patterns.
